services.name: Community Music Lesson Program
services.desc: The Community Music Lesson Program is a need-based initiative that provides free, nine-month music lessons for students ages 7-17 in voice, guitar, piano, or drums. At the end of the program, each student receives a free instrument based on their area of study. Applications for the Community Music Lesson Program should be submitted to CommunityImpact@cainarts.org. Both returning applicants and new students are encouraged to apply. Award decisions will be made after August 11, and recipients will be notified by phone and email. services.name: Puckett Pottery House
services.desc: Students will focus on improving consistency, control, and craftsmanship through projects that may include larger vessels, matching sets, plates, pitchers, and lidded forms. Instruction will cover advanced trimming, altering forms, assembling multipart pieces, and attaching handles and spouts. The course will also introduce surface decoration techniques such as carving, texture, slip application, and glazing considerations. Emphasis is placed on developing strong functional forms, understanding proportion and design, and strengthening problem-solving skills in the studio.
